name: Trade Transaction Condition 4 Code
definition: Specifies the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

CBNS.name: Cum Bonus
CBNS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum bonus.

XBNS.name: Ex Bonus
XBNS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex bonus.

CCPN.name: Cum Coupon
CCPN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum coupon.

XCPN.name: Ex Coupon
XCPN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex coupon.

CDIV.name: Cum Dividend
CDIV.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum dividend.

XDIV.name: Ex Dividend
XDIV.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex dividend.

CRTS.name: Cum Rights
CRTS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum rights.

XRTS.name: Ex Rights
XRTS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex rights.

CWAR.name: Cum Warrant
CWAR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum warrant.

XWAR.name: Ex Warrant
XWAR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex warrant.

SPCU.name: Special Cum Dividend
SPCU.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special cum |dividend, that is, buying after the ex date and getting the dividend.

SPEX.name: Special Ex Dividend
SPEX.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special ex |dividend, that is, selling before the ex date without the coupon.

GTDL.name: Guaranteed Delivery
GTDL.definition: Indicates whether the delivery of the financial instrument on settlement date |is guaranteed.

BCRO.name: Result Option
BCRO.definition: Result of option when set. (UK specific).

BCRP.name: Result Repo
BCRP.definition: Result of repo when set (UK specific).

BCFD.name: Delivery Form
BCFD.definition: Form of delivery, not for foreign registration when unset (UK specific).

BCBL.name: Board Lot
BCBL.definition: Board lots, not set for odd lots (UK specific).

BCBN.name: Bad Name
BCBN.definition: Bad names, not set for good names (UK specific).

MAPR.name: Market Price
MAPR.definition: Trade was executed at market price.

NEGO.name: Negotiated Trade
NEGO.definition: Trade for which the price is not the one quoted but an improved one, that is, the negotiated price.

NMPR.name: Non Market Price
NMPR.definition: Trade was executed outside of normal market conditions, for example, in the case of an iceberg order.

BCPD.name: Deliver Country Incorporation
BCPD.definition: Place of delivery, in country of incorporation when unset (UK specific).
